scenario: AITA for refusing to attend my friend's second wedding and being unsupportive overall? | Excuse me if I make any mistakes. I was the bridesmaid for the wedding between Dia and Jake. Dia was my neighbor and Jake was the son of my mother's colleague, they were like brother and sister to me and we have been close. After dating for 6 years and married for 2 years, Jake passed away suddenly from a fever last March. This year January, Dia announced that she was to be married again, and she wanted me to attend her wedding, date is not set but very likely in a couple of months. I couldn't. I love Dia, and I love Jake too. It just didn't sit well with me that Dia moved on so quickly and I was angry at her and felt sorry for Jake. Jake and Dia are the only true couple in my eyes. Her friends are saying that I am being selfish making it all about myself and not for the bride, that I should be a true friend and be happy and supportive for her. AITA?
